# Hippius S3

> S3-compatible object storage at https://s3.hippius.com. Standard clients (AWS CLI, boto3, minio, the AWS SDK, rclone) work after you change the endpoint, the region, and the keys.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

An S3 API in front of Hippius distributed storage. Credentials are Hippius access keys. The access key id starts with `hip_`. Crypto wallets are not S3 credentials.

Drive (the encrypted folder in the console, desktop app, and mobile app) is a different product. Files in one do not appear in the other.

## When to use it

Use S3 for application data, backups, public files, and presigned links.

Use Drive when a person wants a synced folder. Use Hub (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-hub/main/llms.txt) for models and container images.

## How to get credentials

1. Sign in at https://console.hippius.com (Google, GitHub, or Apple).
2. Add credits on Billing if the account balance is empty. Paying is covered in https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/billing
3. Open the S3 page and create a master token: https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/storage/s3
4. Copy the access key and the secret. The secret is shown once.

Hand an application a sub token scoped to the buckets it needs, not the master token. The console guide is https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/s3

## Connection

- Endpoint: `https://s3.hippius.com` (this host only)
- Region: `decentralized`
- Signature: AWS Signature V4
- Addressing: path-style (`https://s3.hippius.com/<bucket>/<key>`)

## First example

```bash
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="hip_..."
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="..."
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="decentralized"

aws s3 mb s3://my-bucket --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
aws s3 cp file.txt s3://my-bucket/ --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
aws s3 ls s3://my-bucket/ --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
```

```python
import boto3
from botocore.config import Config

s3 = boto3.client(
    "s3",
    endpoint_url="https://s3.hippius.com",
    aws_access_key_id="hip_...",
    aws_secret_access_key="...",
    region_name="decentralized",
    config=Config(signature_version="s3v4", s3={"addressing_style": "path"}),
)
s3.put_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="file.txt", Body=b"hello")
```
